verdict.rationale: Expensify documents an Integration Server API with credential and OAuth2 access that can programmatically download expense report data, which covers the pull side for an external agent. The built-in Ask Expensify AI can create, categorize, tag, approve and reject expenses, and the product auto-categorizes from policies. However, there is no MCP server and no evidence that an external agent can write categorizations or policy flags back via API for review. Missing for 10: MCP server, API write-back of categories/GL coding, API filtering for uncoded transactions, programmatic policy-flag submission, review workflow for agent-proposed coding, independent corroboration.
